hooks.name: Keep the README terrain table in sync
hooks.description: When new terrain trial results are written, refresh the README's Terrain Lab table and explanations.

action.prompt: qa/terrain-trials.json changed. Update the 'Terrain Lab: how each body meets the ground' table in README.md from its pilots[].runs/matrix (pass / stalled / fell, with times for passes). Then check that each robot's structural explanation still matches the measured results, using the numbers in creatures/<bodyId>/body.json (trainability.metrics, dimensions) and eval.json; fix any sentence the new data contradicts. Keep the table columns Dog, Octo, Flower, Cheetah and add a column for any new robot.
